leading.$description: Line height, as a multiple of the font size.

reading.$description: type scale: long-form prose at reading size, and code blocks.

heading.$description: type scale: a section heading: two lines that still read as one shape.

tracking.$description: Letter spacing as a multiple of the font size (CSS em). DTCG dimensions are px or rem only, and tracking must scale with the type.

display.$description: type scale: A heading under display size: the same pull, halved..

wdth.$description: Archivo's and Martian Mono's width axis (font-variation-settings 'wdth').

rule-w.$description: edges: a decorative divider: a keyline between rows or panes.

bar-w.$description: edges: the current item, or the region a status owns: a heavy line on one edge.

focus-gap.$description: edges: the cloth between the keyline and the focus ring's outer ink.

z.$description: The stacking order (z-index), lowest first. Written z-(--z-popover).

lift.$description: stacking: one item over its neighbours inside a component: a focused calendar day, a tab list over its panel's top edge.

sticky.$description: stacking: a sticky table header, an app bar, a form's action bar.

shell.$description: stacking: the application shell's sheet on a phone, and its backdrop.

overlay.$description: stacking: what takes the page away: dialogs, drawers, the palette.

popover.$description: stacking: what is anchored to something, inside an overlay or not: menus, selects, popovers, tooltips, date pickers.

toast.$description: stacking: above everything: a toast has to read over a dialog.

reading.$description: The prose measure, in ch (characters of the element’s own font): max-w-reading.

density.$description: Set by data-density on any element. Each mode lists every density-dependent token; comfortable is the product default.

text-2xs.$description: type scale: label caps, set expanded and tracked.

icon-xs.$description: density: a check inside a 16px box, a sort arrow.

icon-sm.$description: density: beside small text: a chip, a disclosure marker.

icon.$description: density: the default: a button, a menu item, a field.

icon-lg.$description: density: a feature glyph: a callout, an empty state, the palette.
